$description: Token policy for PageSpec node.style (the only per-instance token-override field). Category names are the real catalog categories in tokens/llm/token-catalog.json; verify_all.py resolves every id/category here against the catalog.

paddingBlock.note: Section vertical rhythm is var(--section-y) (144px at 1440, 96px at 375) or none; other spacing steps are internal to components.

rawValueRestrictions.color: Raw hex / rgb() / hsl() / named colours are rejected (TOKEN_RAW_COLOR). Use a surface.*, text.*, accent.* id.
rawValueRestrictions.spacing: Raw px / rem / em / % / vw values are rejected (TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING). Use a spacing id.

themeCombos.$evidence: Dark sections ([data-theme=dark]) switch text to on-night/on-night-2 and accents to lime (CLONE_SPEC.md section 0 shared text roles: eyebrow #C5D69A, lede #C9CBB6 in dark sections); paper sections use ink/olive.
